input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The Agreement is evergreen (§ 2: continues until terminated under § 6), but § 6(a) permits convenience termination only when no uncompleted Statement of Work is outstanding. Because Services are delivered task-by-task under SOWs, we effectively have no convenience exit for the duration of any open SOW — the "missing Customer convenience right" deviation. Conversely, Contractor may walk away on only fifteen (15) days' notice, far short of the 90-day floor. The redline adds our 30-day convenience right over the Agreement or any SOW (in whole or in part), with refund of prepaid fees and no penalty or acceleration, and confines Contractor's convenience right to 90 days' notice when no SOW is open. Fallback: 60 days' notice for us if Contractor resists 30.

proposal.summary: Give Company a 30-day convenience exit from the Agreement or any SOW with refund of prepaid fees, and limit Contractor's convenience right to 90 days' notice when no SOW is outstanding.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need a practical exit: as drafted we can only terminate for convenience when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we are locked in for the life of every SOW, while Contractor can walk on 15 days' notice. We added a 30-day convenience right (with refund of prepaid fees and no penalty) and moved Contractor's convenience right to 90 days' notice when no SOW is open; 60 days for us is an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
ops.newText: (a) Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, for any or no reason upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, without penalty, early-termination charge or acceleration of fees, and Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of such termination. At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, Contractor may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon ninety (90) days advance written notice to Company.
